Subject: Assurance: SOC2 evidence & pen-test window for Order Form RDW-3742

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the demo last week — MedTek is moving quickly and procurement asked me to confirm a few assurance items before we finish the order form. High level asks:

- We need proof of SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted is fine) and a cadence for how you’ll share updates.
- Penetration test access — we need to agree a window and the scope (external vs. host-level).
- Audit / inspection rights language in the Order Form: our legal team prefers a short notice window and a staging environment option.

I attached our internal checklist with required artifacts and a suggested retention period (MedTek-Security-Checklist.xlsx). Can you/your legal team confirm whether Redwood can:
  1) Provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and SOC auditor contact?
  2) Host a mutually scheduled pen-test window in a staging environment or provide a jumpbox/access plan?
  3) Accept evidence sharing via secure drive with weekly snapshots rather than repeated email attachments?

Timing: we’d like to lock the order form next week if we can align on these items.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Looping Laura (security/compliance) and Priyom (legal) to confirm redlines and the runbook. Quick summary of what Redwood can provide today and proposed next steps:

What we can provide
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II attestation + cover letter and the auditor contact for validation (we’ll supply via secure drive).
- Pen-test: we support both external-only and host-level tests in a staging cluster. Typical cadence: one 72-hour window with a 14-day notice; can be compressed with mutual agreement.
- Evidence cadence: we prefer a single read-only secure share (Drive) with weekly snapshot exports for auditors; we will not circulate raw logs by email.

Proposed runbook (high level)
1) Legal: align on audit-rights language and notice period (suggest 30 days).
2) Ops: schedule pen-test window (two options — standard 14-day notice or expedited 72-hour with limited scope).
3) Compliance: upload SOC2 artifacts to secure folder and add auditor access.
4) Delivery: include a short assurance exhibit in the Order Form pointing to the shared drive + contact for evidence requests.

Action items (for next 3 business days)
- Jordan: confirm which artifacts from your checklist are mandatory vs nice-to-have.
- Laura/Priyom: I’ll let you propose Order Form exhibit text and an ops-friendly pen-test cadence.
- Ops/MedTek: suggest two possible windows for the pen-test.

Attached a small excerpt from our report for review (Redwood-SOC2-Excerpt.pdf). I’ll try to draft exhibit language today.

Best,

On Mon, Mar 15, 2027 at 9:10 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Looping Laura (security/compliance) and Priyom (legal) to confirm redlines and the runbook.

Jordan / Aisha — quick legal take to keep things operational and avoid overly broad audit rights. Proposed Order Form exhibit language (draft bullets):

- Audit notice: Redwood will provide written notice of any on-site or staged inspection at least 30 calendar days in advance. Shorter notice may be agreed in writing for expedited reviews.
- Scope: inspections limited to systems and artifacts necessary to validate Redwood’s SOC 2 controls for the services purchased; no unfettered access to Redwood corporate systems.
- Penetration testing: customer-conducted pen tests are permitted against a Redwood-managed staging environment during mutually agreed windows; tests against production require explicit prior approval.
- Evidence exchange: operational artifacts (logs, configs) will be shared via a secure, read-only drive or SFTP with scoped access; Redwood will provide weekly snapshot exports for the duration of active review.
- Redaction & confidentiality: all shared artifacts will be redacted for third-party data and covered under the NDA / DPA.

If MedTek can confirm the minimal artifact set from your checklist, we’ll (1) incorporate the exhibit into the Order Form redline and (2) propose formal pen-test windows. I’ll upload a tracked redline of the Order Form (orderform-redline-v2.docx) to the HubSpot deal and DocuSign once we agree.

Priyom Das
